entries.title: Previous-Day Extreme Sweep Rejection Mechanism Study

parallel_boundary.study: Asian Low Sweep Post-Sweep Rebound Mechanism Study

entries.novelty_statement: This study uses previous UTC trading-day High/Low boundaries, complete trading-day calendar logic and source-native Bid/Ask event chronology. It does not reuse Asian Range boundaries, H4/D1 routing, session-loss state, C1/C2/C3, or any parallel-study result.
retained_findings_used: CSOS separated Asian Range Sweep from Previous-Day Sweep.
HYP-030 failed portfolio MDD despite standalone positive economics, so all portfolio gates remain binding.
HYP-031 found no portable H4/D1 routing rule, so trend routing is not admitted.
HYP-032 failed historical validation with no retuning, so realized-loss state is excluded.
entries.exact_next_action: Complete no-outcome source probe, freeze source-native parser and evaluator, then execute 2023-2024 mechanism development once.
